intro: One of the most-asked questions for this trip: how do you actually get from Bangkok to Krabi? Here are your options compared, with the honest pick for most travelers.

blocks.html: Short answer: A direct flight is fastest and best value — about 1 hour 25 minutes into Krabi Airport, then a transfer to town or Ao Nang. The budget option is a bus from Bangkok, around 12 hours.

blocks.html: A direct flight to Krabi is easiest if fares are reasonable. If Krabi tickets are pricey, flying into Phuket and taking a roughly 3-hour road transfer is a common alternative. The bus suits budget travelers who are not in a rush.

faq.q: How do I get from Krabi Airport to town or Ao Nang?
faq.a: There are minivans, an airport bus, taxis and Grab. Ao Nang is about 30–40 minutes from the airport. You can pre-book a transfer if traveling as a group.

faq.q: Should I fly into Krabi or Phuket?
faq.a: It depends on where you stay and on fares. For Krabi, Ao Nang and Phi Phi, flying into Krabi is more convenient, but Phuket sometimes has cheaper, more frequent flights with a road transfer afterward.
